summary: Independent review of feat/football-refresh-0.27.0 (d8362f0, 670c5fb on main 5a653c7). Builder scripts and results were not reused. (1) Data: both raw CSVs re-read with the reviewer's own parser and an independently inferred team-name mapping; all 60 refreshed matches (EPL 30, La Liga 30) match the provider rows for date, score, shots and shots on target, xG stays null; 18 date changes and the missing Rayo-Athletic result handled as described. (2) predictions.js byte-identical; 30/60 hits (EPL 14, La Liga 16), log loss 0.9953; predictions predate every refreshed match (no leakage). (3) The 2,399 previous matches and all other data blocks are unchanged. check_release still fails every direct edit of data, pages, blocks, engine or predictions, but refresh.json content is not re-validated at check time (R1), and new page edits are legitimised by adding build_pages.py rules (R4, by design; all 16 rules read). (4) No NaN or zero xG in sums, averages, charts, natural-language analysis or /api/analyze; the moved report fixture keeps the cutoff guarantee (report facts unchanged with and without the 60 new results). The featured current-season xG ranking now shows only dashes with no explanation (R2). (5) Browser ko/en x 390/1440: 0 page errors, no overflow, tables and panels as specified. (6) All test suites and check_release PASS. No blocker. Merge gate outside code: the user decision on football-data.co.uk terms (G1). DONE means the review was performed, not final approval.

issues.description: tools/check_release.py and server/check.cjs accept any refresh.json that apply() can consume. The provider rules (date after 2026-09-20 and not after as_of, non-negative integers, shots on target <= shots, result letter) exist only in refresh.py build(), which needs the raw CSV outside the repository. Reviewer tamper on a fresh clone (edit refresh.json, then refresh.py apply and build_pages.py so the ?v= hash follows): score +1, home/away goals swapped, a result dated 2026-09-19, and hst > hs all PASS check_release --write-manifest, test:server and analysis/check. Only an extra (61st) invented result is caught (server/check.cjs count). Before 0.27.0 the data had to equal v50 byte for byte; now it is only as good as refresh.json. Suggested: re-assert the build() invariants inside apply_refresh()/applyRefresh() (date window, integer ranges, hst<=hs, hs/as present, unique ids, all 60 ids are 2026/27 scheduled fixtures) and record a per-row hash of the provider CSV line in refresh.json so a later re-fetch can be compared. The data itself is correct: the reviewer re-read both CSVs independently (see tests).

The featured example button '라리가 이번 시즌 경기당 기대 득점 순위' / 'LaLiga this season xG per match ranking' (default season 2026/27) now returns 20 clubs with '—' and empty grey bars, sorted alphabetically, with no reason given (every club has refreshed matches without xG). Same for every current-season xG team/comparison/venue/ranking question (engine returns value null for all 40 clubs). It is not wrong (no NaN, no 0, header line says 'no xG'), but a promoted example now shows an empty result. Suggested: a one-line note when every value is null because matches after 2026-09-20 lack xG (optionally offer the season up to 2026-09-20), or change the example.

At 390 px the finished-match table shows the match and result columns; the prediction and verdict (hit/miss) columns need horizontal scrolling inside the table area (like other tables). No page overflow (scrollWidth = clientWidth). Consider putting the verdict next to the result on narrow screens.

By design, any page code edit passes check_release if it is added as a rule in design/release-0.27.0/build_pages.py and the pages are rebuilt (reviewer added a rule changing 'probabilities.home' to 'probabilities.home*0.5': PASS, 34 recorded edits). The same holds for identical logic edits in refresh-ui.ko.js and refresh-ui.en.js, and for analysis/record-engine.cjs (pre-existing rule). So the 16 rules x 2 pages must be read by a reviewer; the reviewer read all 16: each only routes xG through hasXg/xgText or null checks; no other behaviour changed.

(a) teamOverview still computes trendMax/line from raw hx (null -> 0) but the variable is unused (dead code, no visible effect). (b) Refreshed rows keep ids 'understat:<n>' while source/provider are football-data.co.uk (stable ids, just a naming caveat). (c) npm run test:report rewrites reports/release-0.25.0/checks.json testedAt (pre-existing; revert before check_release). (d) publication_manifest.json was not regenerated by the reviewer: this commit adds review files, so check_release reports a manifest difference until the manifest is regenerated.

SPEC records that football-data.co.uk data.php says the data is for private individuals and not for commercial or data-training products using automated bots/scrapers/AI. The reviewer did not re-open the site. The user decision required by the SPEC before merge/deploy remains open; the 0.28.0 draft (training on this data) should stay blocked on it.
